name: chat-composer
title: ChatComposer
description: Rounded chat input bar: auto-growing textarea plus voice/send. A pill on one line, rounded-rect once it grows; the mic swaps to a brand-filled send as soon as there is text. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a newline. The consumer positions it. Copy: the placeholder is an invitation, not an instruction manual: one short line naming what this assistant can be asked. It disappears the moment anyone typ
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/ChatComposer.json
